summary: The `gyomu-ai` package provides a robust framework for managing and executing AI operations, built on top of Pydantic AI. It handles model routing, execution policies, tool integration, and result/error mapping to deliver standardized text, object, and embedding generation capabilities.
responsibilities: Implement provider-agnostic execution logic and models for AI text, object, and embedding generation.
Integrate with Pydantic AI to handle agent creation, tool mapping, prompt building, and stream processing.
Manage model registries, routing configurations, and execution policies.
Provide standardized error handling, mapping, and result formatting across AI operations.

capabilities.name: Pydantic AI Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates with Pydantic AI for model execution, prompt construction, agent creation, and streaming capabilities.

capabilities.name: Execution Management
capabilities.description: Manages execution contexts, runtime policies, streaming events, token usage statistics, and result structures for AI interactions.

capabilities.name: AI Tool Execution
capabilities.description: Provides core domain logic, definitions, configurations, and result handling for AI tool execution.

capabilities.name: Model Routing and Registry
capabilities.description: Offers model registries, routing tables, and initialization routines for configuring AI model interactions.

capabilities.name: Error Handling and Mapping
capabilities.description: Defines application-specific error types, exception mapping, and robust error handling for AI operations.

design_decisions: Leverages Pydantic AI as the foundational provider framework for model execution and validation.
Separates core execution parameters and result models from provider-specific implementations.
Uses dedicated routing and registry mechanisms to manage model selections and configurations.
usage_guidance: Configure AI models and routes using the initialization routines and registry providers supplied in the package.
Use the execution parameter and result types to interact with text, object, and streaming generation features consistently.
Define and register tools using the package's tool execution structures for interoperability with AI agents.
